A1_label_free_fit: car only, all five domains, split_mask(video,0)
A1_oracle_reference: F_stage1_e5, all S3 fit RoIs/classes, unchanged rank_basis definitions
A1_energy_test: car only, test videos, P1 ratio-of-sums energy
A2_protocol: S3 exact all-class retrieval and common F_stage1 oracle; model-specific label-free bases
gate_rule: For each model retain both stage1 and stage3; at least one of these two identity estimates must pass. Nuisance k2 must pass in both models. No alternative estimator is introduced.
B_k8_rule: Use k8 only if the same qualifying identity estimate reaches at least 90% of k8 oracle in both F and HF. Prefer a common stage3 estimate; otherwise common stage1; otherwise retain both model-specific gate results explicitly.
on_stage_A_fail: Stop before training-code edits and U/B runs; publish A and explicit skipped U/B tables
